log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (keep every day): kill at most 4 per day, using only national, web and union criminals. Never kill from regional, court, foreign or medical. Reason: if L traces web and union, the pool is 10M x 0.3 x 0.3 = 900k, and police trims could take that to about 540k by day 30, still above 300k. Adding any third source would drop it below 300k, so I would be caught. Timing pattern each day: 2 quick kills in the afternoon plus 2 timed kills in the evening. That way no routine is busy during more than 2 of a day's deaths, so timing never rules anyone out. Daily set: national-1 (timed, evening), web-1 (timed, evening), web-2 (quick, afternoon), union-1 (quick, afternoon). Watch the press conferences: if the pool keeps falling toward 1M or below, cut back to national only.
